kite.name: Kite's Wing
kite.line: Hawks circle high. We hold the fords, we watch the mist, we strike when the river runs red.

rhino.name: General Rhino
rhino.line: Stand firm, protect our fords, and let the valley echo with the thunder of our hooves!

orchid.name: Orchid's Iron Petals
orchid.line: We bloom in mud and blood — hold the fords, break their charge, bring home the standards.

tiger.name: The Iron Stripe
tiger.line: Hold the banks, guard the fords, and let the river run red with the blood of our enemies.

tiger.thought: Initial deployment. F3 is the closest ford. I will secure F3 and the approach at s-east to establish a defensive line, utilizing my infantry and archers for holding and cavalry for screening.
